ocr.notes: Close to the image. Williams' bond is $5000 in print, not $500; first sentence order is 'Ex-Detective Jack Williams and ex-Champion Pugilist Tom Allen'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that a grand jury indicted Tom Allen for murder in the killing of Tim Confoy in his saloon, though he had been discharged after a preliminary hearing on a plea of self-defense.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Thursday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, May 4, 1899, page 9.

facts.fact: After a preliminary hearing in the Court of Criminal Correction, Allen was discharged on a plea of self-defense in the killing of Tim Confoy
places: Court of Criminal Correction, St. Louis

facts.fact: A St. Louis grand jury indicted Allen for murder in the killing of Tim Confoy

notes: Current title 'Tom Allen Gave Bond' does not match: the article reports the indictment, and the bond mentioned is Jack Williams'. Allen shares the item with Williams and the grand jury report, so secondary. Date of the preliminary hearing discharge is not given.
